similarity_declaration.name: V54_V6_HAND_AUTHORED_CONTINUOUS_NEIGHBORHOOD
similarity_declaration.formula: score = covered_weight / total_weight * exp(-sum(weight*abs(query-neighbor)/scale)/covered_weight); missing fields contribute zero coverage and are never imputed
similarity_declaration.orientation: pair legs align by formation-anchor rank, then ticker identity only breaks an exact anchor tie
similarity_declaration.grades: Every neighbor retains its continuous score and coverage; grade is rank N1..N7, not a threshold or gate.
